computed.name: fl_feature_device_fault_count_7d
computed.purpose: device.fault_count_7d: exact Count per complete entity key; population left join keeps zero-event entities
computed.sql:
WITH fl_agg_rows AS (
  SELECT `faults`.`tenant_id` AS `tenant_id`, `faults`.`device_id` AS `device_id`, count(*) AS fl_agg
  FROM fl_fault_events_ai_selected `faults`
WHERE unix_micros(`faults`.`occurred_at`) >= (unix_micros(:as_of) - 604800000000) AND unix_micros(`faults`.`occurred_at`) < unix_micros(:as_of)
  AND coalesce((`faults`.`is_fault` = true), false)
  AND `faults`.`tenant_id` IS NOT NULL AND `faults`.`device_id` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `faults`.`tenant_id`, `faults`.`device_id`
)
SELECT p.`tenant_id`, p.`device_id`,
  CASE WHEN a.fl_present IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS BIGINT) ELSE CAST(a.fl_agg AS BIGINT) END AS fl_value,
  CASE WHEN a.fl_present IS NULL THEN 'empty' ELSE 'ok' END AS fl_state
FROM fl_population_device_reliability p
LEFT JOIN (SELECT *, 1 AS fl_present FROM fl_agg_rows) a ON p.`tenant_id` <=> a.`tenant_id` AND p.`device_id` <=> a.`device_id`

snapshot.name: fl_snapshot_device_reliability
snapshot.purpose: Complete feature-set snapshot: every population key exactly once with every member value and state; published_at stays NULL until commit evidence is recorded
snapshot.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(p.`tenant_id` AS STRING) AS `tenant_id`,
  CAST(p.`device_id` AS STRING) AS `device_id`,
  CAST(m0.fl_value AS BIGINT) AS `device_fault_count_7d`,
  m0.fl_state AS `device_fault_count_7d_state`,
  CAST(:as_of AS TIMESTAMP) AS `feature_as_of`,
  CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS `published_at`,
  CAST(:publication_sequence AS BIGINT) AS `publication_sequence`,
  CAST(:publication_id AS STRING) AS `publication_id`,
  CAST(:materialization_id AS STRING) AS `materialization_id`
FROM fl_population_device_reliability p
JOIN fl_feature_device_fault_count_7d m0 ON p.`tenant_id` <=> m0.`tenant_id` AND p.`device_id` <=> m0.`device_id`

create_table.name: create_feature_table
create_table.purpose: Create the Unity Catalog feature table (resource creation; run only with explicit authorization)
create_table.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `example_catalog`.`synthetic_features`.`device_reliability` (
  `tenant_id` STRING NOT NULL,
  `device_id` STRING NOT NULL,
  `device_fault_count_7d` BIGINT,
  `device_fault_count_7d_state` STRING NOT NULL,
  `feature_as_of` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `published_at` TIMESTAMP,
  `publication_sequence` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `publication_id` STRING NOT NULL,
  `materialization_id` STRING NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `device_reliability_pk` PRIMARY KEY (`tenant_id`, `device_id`, `feature_as_of` TIMESERIES, `publication_sequence`)
) USING DELTA
TBLPROPERTIES ('delta.enableChangeDataFeed' = 'true', 'featlas.feature_set' = 'device_reliability@1.0.0', 'featlas.feature_set_fingerprint' = 'bdaf782a814e94a8341b2400e6069bb859ee91a734443d95c29e62ddc4133680')

publish.name: publish_snapshot
publish.purpose: Single Delta MERGE commit making the complete snapshot visible atomically; idempotent on (keys, as_of, publication_id) for retries
publish.sql:
MERGE INTO `example_catalog`.`synthetic_features`.`device_reliability` t
USING fl_snapshot_device_reliability s
ON t.`tenant_id` = s.`tenant_id` AND t.`device_id` = s.`device_id` AND t.`feature_as_of` = s.`feature_as_of` AND t.`publication_id` = s.`publication_id`
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *

table_properties.name: table_properties
table_properties.purpose: Before publishing, the existing table must carry this feature set's identity and fingerprint

evidence.name: commit_history
evidence.purpose: Read the Delta commit whose userMetadata is this materialization_id; its timestamp is the observed visibility instant

evidence.name: record_published_at
evidence.purpose: Record observed visibility evidence on the rows of this publication only (never fabricated from schedules or job time)
evidence.sql: UPDATE `example_catalog`.`synthetic_features`.`device_reliability` SET `published_at` = CAST(:observed_commit_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE `publication_id` = :publication_id AND `published_at` IS NULL

consumer_read.name: consumer_read
consumer_read.purpose: Physical read for the target-neutral consumer API; the core selects values, applies freshness, null and replay rules
consumer_read.sql: SELECT * FROM `example_catalog`.`synthetic_features`.`device_reliability` WHERE `feature_as_of` <= CAST(:max_as_of AS TIMESTAMP) AND (`tenant_id`, `device_id`) IN (SELECT `tenant_id`, `device_id` FROM fl_request_keys)

parameters.as_of: TIMESTAMP (UTC instant, microsecond precision): the requested feature as_of T
parameters.coverage_state: STRING per degraded feature: core-computed 'insufficient_history' or 'source_unavailable'
parameters.materialization_id: STRING: identity of this write; also the Delta commit userMetadata
parameters.max_as_of: TIMESTAMP: largest as_of among consumer request rows
parameters.observed_commit_timestamp: TIMESTAMP: timestamp of the Delta commit read from DESCRIBE HISTORY

notes: Number sums/means use Spark binary64 accumulation; the local evaluator is correctly rounded. Declared numeric tolerances govern comparison; integer results are exact (BIGINT, ANSI overflow).
Integer/number comparisons follow Spark's widening to DOUBLE, which is inexact above 2^53.
String ordering assumes UTF8_BINARY collation (code-point order); preflight must confirm the table/session collation.
Declared primary keys, foreign keys and cardinalities are verified by the generated assertion queries; Unity Catalog constraints are informational.
Coverage/outage states are computed by the core from source-status evidence; this SQL never infers completeness from row counts.
